flashpoints.counterweight: Also dollar-positive in the short run, which works against gold. The net effect is genuinely ambiguous and often small.
flashpoints.typical_duration: Weeks, when it changes the inflation outlook. Announcement headlines alone rarely stick.
flashpoints.escalation_markers: Rates above expectations, retaliation, or extension to critical minerals and energy.

profile.gotchas: Several speakers a day is normal and almost always noise. Treat as background unless the tone genuinely shifts.

profile.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
profile.what: Survey of purchasing managers. Above 50 means expansion. Released 15:00 UK.
profile.who: Institute for Supply Management, first business day of the month
profile.why_gold: A timely growth signal that arrives before the hard data. Weakness feeds recession pricing, which is usually gold-supportive.
profile.watch: The prices-paid and new-orders sub-indices carry more information than the headline.
profile.gotchas: Manufacturing is a small share of US output, so the survey overstates its own importance.
